```plato

//==
// # Curvilinear coordinates
//
// Positions expressed as radii and angles rather than Cartesian components
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Curvilinear_coordinates). Each alternative
// coordinate system is a distinct type, not a convention layered over
// `Point2D`/`Point3D`, so a polar pair can never be mistaken for a Cartesian one.
// Angles are the `Angle` type throughout (see CONVENTIONS.md - Angles).

// A planar position as distance from origin and angle from the positive X axis
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polar_coordinate_system).
type PolarCoordinate
    implements IValue
{
    Radius: Number;
    Angle: Angle;
}
```
